# Evernote

> Evernote is a comprehensive note-taking and productivity platform that combines AI-powered features with cross-platform synchronization for personal and professional organization.

Evernote offers a full suite of productivity tools including note-taking, task management, document scanning, web clipping, and AI-powered features like transcription, text rewriting, and meeting recording. The platform integrates with popular services like Slack, Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive to streamline workflows across devices.

## Key Topics

- Note-taking

## AI-Powered Tools

- [Evernote - Work smarter with Evernote AI features](https://evernote.com/features/ai-features): Evernote AI features including assistant, semantic search, and LLM integration
- [AI Transcribe by Evernote](https://evernote.com/ai-transcribe): AI Transcribe tool for converting audio, video, and images to text
- [Record & Transcribe Meetings – AI-Powered and Effortless](https://evernote.com/ai-transcribe/meeting): AI meeting transcription and recording with real-time summaries
- [AI Rewrite by Evernote | Rephrase, Improve & Summarize Text with AI](https://evernote.com/ai-rewrite): AI Rewrite tool for text summarization, rephrasing, and improvement
- [AI Text to Voice by Evernote - Free Text to Speech](https://evernote.com/ai-text-to-voice): AI text-to-speech tool for converting documents to audio
- [AI Diagrams by Evernote - Create Diagrams with AI](https://evernote.com/ai-diagrams): AI diagram generator for flowcharts and mindmaps
- [AI Detector by Evernote | Detect AI-Generated Content with Accuracy](https://evernote.com/ai-detector): AI detection tool for identifying AI-generated content
